# Overview

## Row

```{python}
#| title: Profit Margin by Team
import pandas as pd
from itables import show
final_ratings_test = pd.read_csv('v2_test_ratings.csv')
df_sorted = final_ratings_test.sort_values('date').copy()
df_sorted = df_sorted.groupby('team').agg(profit=('profit','sum'),over_picks=('over_pick','sum'),under_picks=('under_pick','sum')).reset_index()
df_sorted['Total Picks'] = df_sorted.over_picks + df_sorted.under_picks
df_sorted['ROI'] = df_sorted.profit/(df_sorted['Total Picks']*10)
df_sorted.ROI = round((df_sorted.ROI*100),1)
df_sorted = df_sorted.sort_values(by='ROI',ascending=False)
df_sorted = df_sorted[['team','ROI','Total Picks']]
show(df_sorted,searching=False,ordering=True,showIndex=False,info=False)
```

```{python}
#| title: Profit Margin By Bet Type
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
final_ratings_test = pd.read_csv('v2_test_ratings.csv')
final_ratings_test = final_ratings_test.query('over_pick != 0 or under_pick != 0')
final_ratings_test['type'] = final_ratings_test.apply(lambda row: 'Over' if row['over_pick'] ==1 else 'Under', axis = 1)
df_sorted = final_ratings_test.groupby('type').agg(profit=('profit','sum'),opicks=('over_pick','sum'),upicks=('under_pick','sum')).reset_index()
df_sorted['roi'] = round((df_sorted.profit/(df_sorted.opicks+df_sorted.upicks)*10),1)
fig = go.Figure()

fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
    x=df_sorted['type'],
    y=df_sorted['roi'],width=[0.3,0.3]
)).update_layout(yaxis_title="ROI")
```

## Row

```{python}
#| title: Cumulative Units of Profit for Test Data
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
final_ratings_test = pd.read_csv('v2_test_ratings.csv')
df_sorted = final_ratings_test.sort_values('date').copy()
df_sorted['date'] = df_sorted['date'].astype(str)
df_sorted = df_sorted.groupby('date').agg(profit=('profit','sum'),over_picks=('over_pick','sum'),under_picks=('under_pick','sum')).reset_index()
df_sorted['cumulative_profit'] = df_sorted['profit'].cumsum()
df_sorted['cumulative_profit']= df_sorted['cumulative_profit']/10

fig = go.Figure()

fig.add_trace(go.Scatter(
    x=df_sorted['date'],
    y=df_sorted['cumulative_profit'],
    mode='lines',
    line=dict(color='steelblue', width=3)
)).update_layout(yaxis_title="Units",
    xaxis=dict(type='category', tickangle=45, nticks=10)
)
```

```{python}
#| title: Profit Margin By Pitch/Batter Matchup
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
final_ratings_test = pd.read_csv('v2_test_ratings.csv')
final_ratings_test = final_ratings_test.query('stand !="S"').reset_index(drop=True)
final_ratings_test['matchup'] = 'zero'
for i in range(len(final_ratings_test)):
  if final_ratings_test.p_throws[i] == 'L' and final_ratings_test.stand[i] == 'L':
    final_ratings_test.matchup[i] = 'L/L'
  elif final_ratings_test.p_throws[i] == 'L' and final_ratings_test.stand[i] == 'R':
    final_ratings_test.matchup[i] = 'L/R'
  elif final_ratings_test.p_throws[i] == 'R' and final_ratings_test.stand[i] == 'L':
    final_ratings_test.matchup[i] = 'R/L'
  else:
    final_ratings_test.matchup[i] = 'R/R'
df_sorted = final_ratings_test.groupby('matchup').agg(profit=('profit','sum'),over_picks=('over_pick','sum'),under_picks=('under_pick','sum')).reset_index()
df_sorted['picks'] = df_sorted.under_picks + df_sorted.over_picks
df_sorted['ROI'] = (df_sorted.profit/df_sorted.picks)*10
df_sorted = df_sorted.sort_values(by='ROI',ascending=False)
fig = go.Figure()

fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
    x=df_sorted['matchup'],
    y=df_sorted['ROI'],width=[.3,.3,.3,.3]
)).update_layout(yaxis_title="ROI")
```

# Overs

## Row

```{python}
#| title: Profit By Stadium
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
final_ratings_test = pd.read_csv('v2_test_ratings.csv')
final_ratings_test = final_ratings_test.query('over_pick == 1')
df_sorted = final_ratings_test.groupby('home').agg(profit=('profit','sum'),picks=('over_pick','sum')).reset_index()
df_sorted.profit = df_sorted.profit/10
df_sorted = df_sorted.sort_values(by='profit',ascending=False)
fig = go.Figure()

fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
    x=df_sorted['home'],
    y=df_sorted['profit']
)).update_layout(yaxis_title="Profit (Units)").update_xaxes(tickangle=300)
```

```{python}
#| title: Home Run Prediction Error By Rating Bin
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
final_ratings_test = pd.read_csv('v2_test_ratings.csv')
final_ratings_test = final_ratings_test.reset_index(drop=True)
final_ratings_test['Rating Bin'] = final_ratings_test.rating.round()
for i in range(len(final_ratings_test)):
  if final_ratings_test['Rating Bin'][i] >= 8:
    final_ratings_test['Rating Bin'][i] = '8+'
  else:
    continue
df_sorted = final_ratings_test.groupby('Rating Bin').agg(Sportsbook=('over','mean'),Model=('pred_over','mean'),Actual=('hr','mean')).reset_index()
df_sorted['Rating Bin'] = df_sorted['Rating Bin'].astype(str) 
fig = go.Figure(data=[go.Bar(name='Actual',x=df_sorted['Rating Bin'],y=df_sorted['Actual'], showlegend=False),go.Bar(name='Model',x=df_sorted['Rating Bin'],y=df_sorted['Model'], showlegend=False),go.Bar(name='Sportsbook',x=df_sorted['Rating Bin'],y=df_sorted['Sportsbook'], showlegend=False)]).update_layout(
    barmode='group',
    yaxis_title="Mean",
    annotations=[
        dict(x=0.02, y=1.08, xref='paper', yref='paper', showarrow=False,
             text='<span style="color:#636EFA">■</span> Actual'),
        dict(x=0.16, y=1.08, xref='paper', yref='paper', showarrow=False,
             text='<span style="color:#EF553B">■</span> Model'),
        dict(x=0.35, y=1.08, xref='paper', yref='paper', showarrow=False,
             text='<span style="color:#00CC96">■</span> Sportsbook'),
    ]
)


#.update_layout(legend=dict(
#       orientation="h",yanchor="top",y=.99,xanchor="left",
#      x=.01),margin=dict(t=40))
fig.show()
```

```{python}
#| title: Profit Margin By Edge Bin
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
final_ratings_test = pd.read_csv('v2_test_ratings.csv')
final_ratings_test = final_ratings_test.query('over_pick == 1')
final_ratings_test['over%'] = final_ratings_test.apply(lambda row: 'Over 5.5% Edge' if row['over_diff'] >= .055 else 'Under 5.5% Edge', axis = 1)
df_sorted = final_ratings_test.groupby('over%').agg(profit=('profit','sum'),picks=('over_pick','sum')).reset_index()
df_sorted['roi'] = round((df_sorted.profit/df_sorted.picks*10),1)
fig = go.Figure()

fig.add_trace(go.Bar(
    x=df_sorted['over%'],
    y=df_sorted['roi'],width=[.3,.3]
)).update_layout(yaxis_title="ROI")
```

```{python}
#| title: Distribution of Bets By Rating Bin
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
final_ratings_test = pd.read_csv('v2_test_ratings.csv')
final_ratings_test = final_ratings_test.query('over_pick == 1')
final_ratings_test = final_ratings_test.reset_index(drop=True)
final_ratings_test['Rating Bin'] = final_ratings_test.rating.round()
for i in range(len(final_ratings_test)):
  if final_ratings_test['Rating Bin'][i] >= 8:
    final_ratings_test['Rating Bin'][i] = '8+'
  else:
    continue
df_sorted = final_ratings_test.groupby('Rating Bin').agg(profit=('profit','sum'),picks=('over_pick','sum')).reset_index()
df_sorted['roi'] = round((df_sorted.profit/df_sorted.picks*10),1)
df_sorted.profit = df_sorted.profit/10
fig = go.Figure(data=[go.Pie(
    labels=df_sorted['Rating Bin'],
    values=df_sorted.picks,
    showlegend=False,
    marker=dict(colors=['#F4845F', '#8338EC', '#06D6A0'])
)]).update_layout(
    annotations=[
        dict(x=0.04, y=1.1, xref='paper', yref='paper', showarrow=False,
             text='<span style="color:#F4845F">■</span> 6'),
        dict(x=0.14, y=1.1, xref='paper', yref='paper', showarrow=False,
             text='<span style="color:#8338EC">■</span> 7'),
        dict(x=0.24, y=1.1, xref='paper', yref='paper', showarrow=False,
             text='<span style="color:#06D6A0">■</span> 8+'),
    ]
)
fig.show()
```

```{python}
#| title: Home Run Prediction Error By Rating Bin
import pandas as pd
import plotly.graph_objects as go
final_ratings_test = pd.read_csv('v2_test_ratings.csv')
final_ratings_test = final_ratings_test.reset_index(drop=True)
final_ratings_test['Rating Bin'] = final_ratings_test.rating.round()
for i in range(len(final_ratings_test)):
  if final_ratings_test['Rating Bin'][i] >= 8:
    final_ratings_test['Rating Bin'][i] = '8+'
  else:
    continue
df_sorted = final_ratings_test.groupby('Rating Bin').agg(Sportsbook=('under','mean'),Model=('pred_under','mean'),Actual=('hr','mean')).reset_index()
df_sorted.Actual = 1-df_sorted.Actual
df_sorted['Rating Bin'] = df_sorted['Rating Bin'].astype(str) 
fig = go.Figure(data=[go.Bar(name='Actual',x=df_sorted['Rating Bin'],y=df_sorted['Actual'], showlegend=False),go.Bar(name='Model',x=df_sorted['Rating Bin'],y=df_sorted['Model'], showlegend=False),go.Bar(name='Sportsbook',x=df_sorted['Rating Bin'],y=df_sorted['Sportsbook'], showlegend=False)]).update_layout(

        dict(x=0.02, y=1.08, xref='paper', yref='paper', showarrow=False,
             text='<span style="color:#636EFA">■</span> Actual'),
        dict(x=0.16, y=1.08, xref='paper', yref='paper', showarrow=False,
             text='<span style="color:#EF553B">■</span> Model'),
        dict(x=0.35, y=1.08, xref='paper', yref='paper', showarrow=False,

)
```
